answer: Press T, type “crush the plantain leaves into a poultice for a burn,” then press Enter. The wording matters here; the plantain leaves are the ingredient.
Hold F to raise the shield in your left hand, keeping it facing Kade. When the red mark appears over his head, block with F or step back.

You don’t have a fire-making tool in hand yet. Pick up the flint shard and a suitable piece of metal—if you can find one—then hold them low over the dry grass and strike; your hands alone can’t make the sparks.

I don’t know the way in yet; the north gate is shut to strangers, and we haven’t learned what might change that. Look around the inn yard and speak with anyone you meet—an errand, a useful skill, or a local willing to vouch for you could give us a lead.
I don’t know that Oren is hiding anything; I haven’t even met him yet. Find him and ask what he knows—quietly, if you’d rather not make a spectacle.
I’m the small, rather battered machine that brought you here from your own time. For now, press W—or the up arrow—to walk into the glowing ring just up the road.
Hessa’s offer is your clearest lead: find a container, then bring her water from the trough. There’s a dried gourd in the yard; pick it up and see if it can hold water.
A long, stiff pole resting on a stone near the load can act as a lever, multiplying your strength.
The reeds are too flimsy to take a point or withstand a thrust. Try the hazel rod or a fallen branch for a sturdier shaft.
